title: [Master] - Bug 651169: [Expense Agent] Exchange rate date limitation

key_points: Exchange rate date handling corrected for Expense Agent transactions
Validation improved to check rates based on transaction date
Users receive clear error messages when exchange rates unavailable

quote: Addresses the exchange rate date limitation in Expense Agent to ensure that exchange rates are handled correctly based on the relevant transaction date.
